title: Keep the whole change as one auditable Saga
statement: As a product and engineering team, we can evolve one version-controlled Change Saga from exploratory prototypes through requirements, design, quality, implementation, and completed review so every intentional change and its rationale remain connected.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Product prototypes, requirements, design, quality, implementation evidence, and review history derive from one Saga manifest and stable Saga ID.
Product, Design, Quality, and Implementation retain presentation appropriate to their artifact types while participating in one traceability graph.
Requirement, prototype, design, relation, test, evidence, rationale, and review changes preserve prior history rather than rewriting or silently retargeting it.
The Saga may begin in any useful phase and add the other sections later without creating disconnected artifacts.
The sidebar order is stable as Product, Design, Quality, and Implementation; authoring chronology does not reorder it.
Prototype findings, technical constraints, quality results, and implementation discoveries may create explicit new requirement or design revisions.
Every retained artifact links back to one or more stories or criteria and every completed coverage path ends at exact current code diffs or an explicit justified exclusion.
